rationale: No loop YAML pairs terminal:true with a blocking action_type:shell; executor's 3600s wall-clock fallback SIGKILLs shell actions on timeout, incompatible with FSM-A's indefinite Ctrl-C-wait design. FSM-B reuses the existing run.py:627 signal-handler hook and run_background() detached-Popen pattern.
rule: Option FSM-B: run ll-artifact serve-run outside the FSM (post-loop hook or manual command), not as a terminal shell state
alternatives_rejected: Option FSM-A: append a serve state to the loop YAML (action_type: shell, terminal: true) that blocks on Ctrl-C inside the FSM
